subject: MAP: ownership, timeline & signature gate — Voronoi
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Levine <sara.levine@voronoi.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: ownership, timeline & signature gate — Voronoi

Hi Sara / Thomas —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery and the follow-up with procurement, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v0.9.xlsx) and a redline-friendly SOW draft. High level summary and asks below so we have a clear playbook for the next three weeks: 

Milestones (target close = 2025-06-20):
- Prod pilot approval (customer security) — owner: Voronoi (Thomas) — blocker: SOC2 attestation + SSO testing
- Contract signature / DocuSign — owner: Voronoi procurement (Sara) — target signature date: 2025-06-18 (PO cutoff 2025-06-18 EOD)
- Tech onboarding kickoff (internal) — owner: Redwood (Ben) — contingent on signed SOW and access
- Billing/PO affirmation — owner: Voronoi finance — PO needs to be issued by 2025-06-18 to guarantee the committed capacity and pricing in the quote

Dependencies / Risks:
- SOC 2 evidence: we can share the SOC 2 package within 48 hours; if security requires an external review window >3 business days, that could push the signature date
- SSO integration: test account needed by 6/10 to meet pilot schedule
- Procurement windows: if PO is issued after 6/18 we may need to re-confirm capacity or pricing (we can hold the current pricing through 6/23 with a signed commitment to deliver PO by then; see note below)

Next steps I recommend this week:
1) Voronoi: confirm procurement PO cutoff (is 6/18 firm?) and identify the primary contact who will sign the DocuSign envelope
2) Voronoi: provide any outstanding security checklist items by 6/03 so our security team can triage
3) Redwood: Ben to schedule a 30m SSO test slot for 6/10–6/11; we’ll share access instructions
4) Redwood: I’ll circulate MAP v1 with owners and a simplified sign-off workflow by Monday (6/02)

Attachments: MAP_v0.9.xlsx (milestones, owners, deadlines), SOW-draft.pdf (commercial + technical scope)

If the PO/contract signature runway is tight on your side, flag it here and we’ll propose an alternative acceptance path (e.g., deposit or conditional access for pilot).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

---
Attachment stubs:
- MAP_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- SOW-draft.pdf (PDF)
From: Sara Levine <sara.levine@voronoi.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Thomas Grant <thomas.grant@voronoi.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: ownership, timeline & signature gate — Voronoi

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear recap and the MAP. A few notes from procurement/finance: our internal PO window for this quarter is pretty locked down. We have a procurement freeze that starts 06/21; realistically the latest we can route an approved PO to you is EOD 06/20, but signing in DocuSign may not be able to complete until 06/23 depending on legal review capacity. 

Questions:
- Is PO issue on 06/20 sufficient to secure capacity and price, or does DocuSign need to be completed by 06/18?
- If legal pushes signature to 06/23, will Redwood hold the quoted pricing and capacity?

I can escalate on our side, but need to be transparent about procurement calendar.

Sara Levine
Senior Procurement Manager | Voronoi Systems
sara.levine@voronoi.com | +1 212-555-0177

On the security checklist: Thomas will send the remaining items by EOD 06/03.

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Levine <sara.levine@voronoi.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: ownership, timeline & signature gate — Voronoi

Sara / Kimberly —

Quick answer on the procurement vs signature runway: PO Issued by 06/20 will secure the committed capacity and quoted pricing. We treat the PO issuance as the commercial commitment for reserved capacity; however, the legal signature (DocuSign) should be completed as soon as your legal team allows. To be explicit: if we receive a confirmed PO by 2025-06-20 23:59 local time, Redwood will:

- Hold the quoted pricing and reserve the capacity tied to this deal through 2025-06-23 23:59 — giving your legal team a 3-day buffer for signature.
- If DocuSign is not completed by 06/23 23:59, we will need to re-confirm capacity and price; we will not retroactively penalize for a delayed signature, but capacity is subject to availability.

Operational asks: 
- Ben to run SSO test 06/10 — Kimberly please confirm a 30m slot; we need test credentials by 06/09 EOD.
- Marissa will prepare a trimmed acceptance checklist (pilot success criteria) to make legal review faster — CCed.

We can also accept a signed Letter of Intent + PO as an alternative if legal needs more time on the SOW redlines.

If that runway works, I’ll update MAP_v1 to include the PO cutoff and the 3-day signature buffer and circulate.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Levine <sara.levine@voronoi.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: ownership, timeline & signature gate — Voronoi

Sara —

Thanks for the heads-up. That PO/DocuSign cadence is workable from our side. Action items we’ll take on now:

- I’ll publish MAP_v1 (owners + PO cutoff 06/20 + 3-day DocuSign buffer to 06/23) and send the DocuSign envelope the same day we receive your PO copy.
- Ben will confirm the 30m SSO test slot for 06/10 and follow up with the test account instructions by 06/09 EOD.
- Marissa will package the SOC2 summary and a short onboarding checklist to speed legal review.

Can you confirm: who at Voronoi will be the primary signer on the DocuSign envelope (name & email) and the finance contact who will issue the PO? If you can drop those two names here, I’ll update the MAP owners column.

If anything changes on your procurement end, flag it in this thread and we’ll escalate. Otherwise I’ll share MAP_v1 on Monday morning.

Appreciate the partnership —
Kimberly
